description: This file defines the class CompatTabHoneycomb, an implementation of a tab interface for Android's ActionBar API levels 11 and above, encapsulating interactions with ActionBar.Tab and managing tab-related callbacks and fragment handling.

classes.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
classes.description: Implementation of CompatTab interface for API 11 using ActionBar.Tab, facilitating tab creation, customization, and callback management with fragments.

methods.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new tab with a given activity and tag, creating a new ActionBar.Tab.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the display text of the tab using a resource ID.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon of the tab using a resource ID.

methods.name: setTabListener
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener to respond to tab events.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the current text label of the tab.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the current icon of the tab.

methods.name: getTab
methods.description: Returns the underlying native ActionBar.Tab object.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Returns the assigned tab callback listener.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the tab is reselected; triggers fragment transaction disallowing adding to back stack and calls the user-defined callback.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Callback triggered when the tab is selected; initiates fragment transaction similarly.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Callback when the tab becomes unselected; manages fragment transaction accordingly.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Assigns a fragment to this tab for display.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment associated with this tab.
